channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Big Wins, Finals Secured & A Huge Week Ahead
item.description: Grade 2 Ladies 'A' and Grade 2 Mens recorded 4–0 wins to secure League Final and Semi-Final spots, while Grade 6 Mens reached the Cup Final. A huge week follows with the final league games, Doubles Quarter-Finals, and Cup Semi-Finals. No club night this Wednesday due to MBA Quarter-Finals in Claremont Stadium.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Badminton Weekly Round-Up: Big Wins and Big Finals
item.description: A strong week for Navan badminton with a 4–0 win for the Grade 7 Ladies and a runners-up finish for Grade 2 Mixed 'A'. Plenty of league and cup action ahead as the season nears its climax.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Badminton Round-Up: Cup Semi-Final Secured & Big League Matches Ahead
item.description: A busy week of badminton with hard-fought draws, a Cup win on points for our Grade 6 Mens to reach the Semi-Final, and key league fixtures coming up. Note: No club night on Wednesday 4th March—adult club nights are Monday 2nd and Thursday 5th.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 13 Matches Played, Big Wins & Cup Drama
item.description: A busy week of 13 matches featuring strong away wins, hard-earned draws, and dramatic cup ties—now it’s on to 14 fixtures next week across Meath League, Dublin League, and the Meath Cup.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 11 Matches Played
item.description: A busy week of 11 matches featuring big wins, hard-fought draws, dramatic cup action, and a packed 13-game schedule ahead.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
